input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: The Agreement meets the preferred position: Section 2.1 expressly states that no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies, that Customer pays only for Services ordered under a signed Order Form, and that declining to place further orders is neither a breach nor a shortfall. Section 7.1 bars Vendor from imposing any minimum-use or similar charge not identified in the Order Form, and Section 12.3 confirms Customer has given no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment. Section 4.1 makes quantity changes a matter of mutually signed change orders, and Section 8.2 lets Customer exit each Order Form on thirty days' notice of non-renewal with no no-downgrade restriction. The only "shortfall" references (Sections 22.2–22.3) are audit true-ups for under-reported usage, not take-or-pay penalties, and payment of a shortfall resolves the issue. No volume caps on Customer usage appear; no redline needed.
